Covers the nine 2026-11-15 games and the eight 2026-11-16 games; it prints no 11/17 or 11/18 rows at all.

rule_quote: By 5 p.m. local time the day before a game (other than the second day of a back-to-back), teams must designate a participation status and identify a specific injury, illness, other medical condition, or other reason for any player whose participation in the game may be affected for any reason. For the second game of a back-to-back, teams must report the above information by 1 p.m. local time on the day of the game. In addition, teams are required to submit a game-day injury report between 11 a.m. and 1 p.m. local time (and between 8 and 10 a.m. for tip-offs 5 p.m. or earlier) on game days (besides the second game of a back-to-back).

teams_reporting_no_rows_note: A team that filed but named nobody prints no row, and so does a team whose block fell off the page; the PDF cannot distinguish them. Each listed side is published UNKNOWN, never as an absence count of zero. Flag F-BB-02.
prior_report_note: NOT COMPARED BY THIS CAPTURE, on purpose. The 01:30 PM ET report is a report for the 2026-11-14 game day; this capture is a report for the 2026-11-15 game day. They cover different games, so a row-for-row delta between them would compare two different questions, and a published '0 status changes' over '0 rows compared' would read like agreement when nothing was compared. The meaningful comparison is this report against the 06:00 AM read of the same 11/15 document: the two reads agree on every (team, player, status, reason) row that both print, and the 06:15 file is adopted only because it is newer and the index advanced to it between the two reads.
